headline: Brazil's External Debt Tops Foreign Assets for First Time in 19 Years
summary: Central bank data shows Brazil's debt reached $407.1 billion, exceeding its foreign assets for the first time in 19 years.
why: Net external debtor status can influence sovereign credit ratings, currency volatility, and international borrowing costs for emerging economies.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Net external liabilities heighten vulnerability to foreign exchange swings and global credit tightening.
